refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to create a lexer object

refsynopsisdiv.programlisting: SilikoLexer *SilikoLexerCreate( SilikoInput *source, bool support_dice, bool support_constants);

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoLexerCreate function creates a new SilikoLexer object using source as the input. If support_dice is set to true, then the d operator will be supported, otherwise it will be treated as a normal identifier. If support_constants is set to true, the lexer will support treating e and pi as real values, otherwise they are treated as identifiers.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoLexerCreate returns a pointer to a new SiikoLexer object if there was no memory error, or NULL if there was a memory error.
